vo: Every supplier wants your purchase orders a different way. A PDF here. A CSV there. cXML, EDI, a custom XML. So your team reformats orders by hand, and the mistakes get expensive.
ProcuLink is the bridge. One place to take any incoming order and send it out in exactly the format and channel each supplier needs.
Drop in an order. CSV, Excel, PDF, XML, or cXML. ProcuLink detects the format automatically and gets to work.
It parses every line, and surfaces only the lines that actually need your attention. Not the whole order.
When a supplier uses different item codes, the AI suggests the mapping, with a confidence score and the reason behind it, and it remembers your corrections for next time.
Before anything goes out, the order is checked against that supplier's own acceptance rules, so it isn't rejected at the other end.
Then ProcuLink transforms the order into the supplier's required format, and delivers it. Over HTTP, SFTP, email, or straight into their ERP.
Every step is logged. A complete audit trail and proof of delivery for each order. Boringly reliable, by design. ProcuLink. Try it with a sample order today.
